snippet.title: Backpack Boy release date trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
Backpack Boy is off on one of his treks when he discovers a peculiar flashlight that changes the world around him. Explore a seemingly abandoned structure in this puzzle platformer built around using light to shine into the past.

Backpack Boy by @Niles_Games  and Chuck is releasing August 10th, 2026!

Backpack Boy in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/backpack-boy/
Backpack Boy on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2875150/Backpack_Boy/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkygames.com/events/direct/2026/
